deploy-bot: starting canary v3.8.1 -> canary (us-east-2) at 04:07 UTC. canary=4%. smoke suites: quickwatch + prefix-probe (sample 25). prefill + tokenizer-primer queued. dashboard: https://dash/release/1775001235 :rocket:
hana: heads up — infra asked to shift window earlier by 20m, please reduce prefix-probe fanout from 12 -> 4.
mike: noted. lowering fanout. also ensure tokenizer-primer finishes before probes (last week we overlapped).
sre-oncall: I'll monitor p95 and 5xxs. threshold: p95 >+15% or 5xx >=8 in 10m -> alert.
deploy-bot: tokenizer-primer started (est 6m). probes paused until primer completes.
hana: primer logs show 12 nodes primed, no errors. starting prefix-probe (fanout=4) at 04:15 UTC.
mike: initial probe: 25 samples -> p50 98ms p95 420ms baseline p95 390ms errors 1 (429). seems close but slightly high.
sre-oncall: seeing p95 +8% and a small spike of 429s. not hitting alert threshold yet. recommend hold canary for us-east-2 for 15m and rerun probes after primer TTL refresh.
hana: holding canary for us-east-2. do not continue ramp for that region. other regions continue.
deploy-bot: action: isolate-pin us-east-2 -> v3.8.0 at 04:28 UTC. incident created INC-20260324-2201 (monitoring, low).
mike: quick rerun plan: refresh tokenizer cache, wait 45s, rerun prefix-probe with fanout=4 samples=30.
hana: ran refresh, rerun results: 30 samples -> p50 95ms p95 385ms errors 0. within baseline.
sre-oncall: recommend unpin and slow ramp: 4% -> 18% over 20m. keep probes active for 45m.
mike: unpinning and scheduling ramp at 04:45 UTC. follow-up: add a 60s buffer between primer completion and any probe start in deploy orchestration. logging RUN-20260324-05.
hana: adding note to release notes: "v3.8.1: tokenizer primer buffer added; conservative ramp in us-east-2 due to probe overlap."
deploy-bot: rollout resumed; status us-east-2 -> v3.8.1 (ramp 4%->18% over 20m). summary: https://dash/release/1775001235/summary :white_check_mark:
